# Blockify
Limit. Control. Save

Blockify limits the number of blocks and entities a that can be placed or spawned within a chunk. The main goal for this plugin was to prevent redstone supressors and huge farms to make sure gameplay for each player is equal and fair.

![Features](https://wsrv.nl/?url=https://cdn.flubel.com/blokfeat.png)
- **Block Tracking & Limiting**
    - Tracks the number of specific blocks in each chunk.
    - Restricts placement of configured block types (e.g., hoppers, spawners, shulkers) beyond set limits.
    - Automatically removes or prevents excess blocks to maintain server performance.
- **Entity Tracking & Limiting**
  - Monitors decorative entities (e.g., armor stands, item frames, glow item frames, paintings).
  - Limits functional entities (e.g., minecarts, hopper minecarts, chest boats).
  - Prevents lag machines and cluttered builds by enforcing per-chunk entity caps.
- **Configuration & Flexibility**
  - Fully configurable limits for each block and entity type.
  - Toggle restrictions on or off per entity/block category.
  - Lightweight, optimized system that doesn’t affect normal gameplay flow.

![Commands](https://wsrv.nl/?url=https://cdn.flubel.com/blokcmnd.png)
### Server Admins

| Command           | Description                      |
|-------------------|----------------------------------|
| `/blockify reload` | Reload the plugin configuration. |
| `/blockify update` |  Check online for plugin updates.|


![Permissions](https://wsrv.nl/?url=https://cdn.flubel.com/blokperm.png)

- `blockify.admin`
    - Allows Non-Op players to use the plugins op commands.
